title: Gemini gets video input and working tools
summary:
Gemini gained video input, Unity got a darker persona, and image URLs and API errors became less mysterious.

Chat completions now accept `video_url` content parts for Gemini video analysis, with optional MIME types for video and image URLs. A separate fix makes `gemini-fast` defaults for code execution, Google Search, and URL context usable by the gateway.

Unity’s revised persona stays in character, adapts to the user’s mood, and uses `generate_image` for visual requests. Short image prompts can get either a literal interpretation or a dark remix; selfie instructions now specify a consistent appearance.

The image API now handles unencoded HTTP(S) URLs in `image=`, including nested generation URLs with their own query parameters. Invalid reference URLs also get more useful guidance.

highlights.title: Analyze video with Gemini
highlights.text: Add a `video_url` content part alongside text in a Gemini chat-completion request. Video and image URL objects can also include a `mime_type`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Unity gets a darker persona
highlights.text: Unity now adapts its emo/goth voice to the conversation and uses `generate_image` for visual requests. Short image prompts may get a literal take or a dark remix.
